title: Gulf Coast road trips and travelling by car and truck
summary: Howard describes weekly jobs across Mississippi, Alabama and the Gulf Coast, renting cars and later riding in a truck with Morgan.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh Lutzenz? Who's that? The Jew, everybody's that. Yeah. I played all out there. And in fact, I mean I've been a lot of places on the early start. I used to, one week I'd be on the Gulf Coast, next week I'd be going to Meridian, and Harrisburg, Poplarville, Picayune, all them places like that slide out. You know one week we'd go to this place, next week then we'd go to Mobile, Pensacola, Florida, and back into Biloxi, Gulf Coast, Paris Christian, Bay St. Louis.
How did you travel usually in the United States? Well, we had cars.

People had some of those type of cars. Yeah cars, you see. All we would have we'd rent them, see. Yeah. Rent the cars. And then we, when I'd taken up with Isley Morgan, they had a truck. We'd just travel the truck. Couldn't go. It was 25 miles an hour.

But we were slow by the show. Well I'd have to sit in the back of the truck then. Yeah, we'd be in the back of the truck. And just go on the road. Let's see if there's anything else about the dance halls we could talk about. About how many girls did they usually hire there?
